title: To become a better writer, read as much as you can
summary: A blog post on NapperTime discussing the fundamental principle that reading extensively is the key to improving one's writing skills. The article gained significant traction on Hacker News with 316 points and 208 comments, indicating strong community agreement with this timeless writing advice.
problem_solved: Addresses the common question of how to become a better writer through the simple but powerful advice of extensive reading.
why_valuable: Provides universally applicable, time-tested wisdom that reading widely exposes writers to diverse styles, vocabulary, and structures that naturally improve their own writing.
